description: Establish a green baseline and add the deck.gl dependency. Confirm the existing branch builds/lints/tests clean, then install the deck.gl packages needed for the GoogleMapsOverlay + ScatterplotLayer dot visualization. No component logic changes in this feature. Independent prerequisite for FEAT-002.
steps: Run `npm install` to ensure node_modules is present (Node v22.23.3 in sandbox is fine).
Establish baseline: `npm run typecheck`, `npm run lint`, and `npx vitest run src/test/VayuLokLive.test.tsx`. All must pass (baseline is 22 tests green). Record counts.

Add the deck.gl packages used by the dot overlay: `@deck.gl/core`, `@deck.gl/layers`, and `@deck.gl/google-maps`. Install as runtime dependencies (npm install <pkgs>), which updates package.json + package-lock.json. If deck.gl requires a peer such as `@luma.gl/core`, install the matching peer version npm reports. Pin whatever versions the registry resolves; do not hand-edit versions.

If the npm registry is unreachable in this environment, STOP and mark this feature blocked with retryable=true, detail='deck.gl install requires npm registry access which is unavailable in this network mode' - do NOT vendor or fake the dependency.

After install, re-run `npm run typecheck` and `npm run lint` to confirm adding the dependency did not break resolution. (deck.gl is only imported dynamically in FEAT-002, so types should still pass here.)
acceptance_criteria: `npx vitest run src/test/VayuLokLive.test.tsx` passes all tests.
package.json dependencies include @deck.gl/core, @deck.gl/layers, @deck.gl/google-maps (and any required peer); package-lock.json is updated accordingly.
verification: node -e "const p=require('./package.json');const d={...p.dependencies,...p.devDependencies};['@deck.gl/core','@deck.gl/layers','@deck.gl/google-maps'].forEach(k=>{if(!d[k])throw new Error('missing '+k)});console.log('deck.gl deps present')"
findings: npm registry reachable; install succeeded. Baseline (before deck.gl): typecheck exit 0, lint exit 0 (0 errors, 203 warnings - warnings only), vitest 22/22 passed. Added runtime deps resolved by registry: @deck.gl/core ^9.4.0, @deck.gl/google-maps ^9.4.0, @deck.gl/layers ^9.4.0 (all 9.4.0). Peer @luma.gl/core@9.4.2 pulled in transitively and deduped automatically; npm did not require a separate direct peer install. After install: typecheck exit 0, lint exit 0 (unchanged 203 warnings), vitest 22/22 passed, deck.gl deps-present check passed. package.json + package-lock.json updated (npm also re-sorted the dependencies block alphabetically, moving the existing 'material' entry - benign). No component logic changed. Node v22.23.3 (EBADENGINE warning vs required >=24 is expected and harmless).
